scope: Independent original-method reintegration of every saved candidate. No new prediction step, env.step, planner, optimizer or training. Equality verifies fixed-pool shooting, not continuous TO superiority.
extra_geometry_cost: Original observation calls interval once; manual execution calls it again. Interval/reference counts include both, and fallback is evaluated in every arm. Same candidate count is not equal runtime.

hash_semantics.protocol_sha256: byte SHA-256 of executed frozen protocol
hash_semantics.source_results_sha256: byte SHA-256 of saved result input used for this check
hash_semantics.script_sha256: byte SHA-256 of the unchanged executed script
hash_semantics.suffix_content_sha256: canonical UTF-8 content hash after CRLF-to-LF normalization; no scientific result recalculated
hash_semantics.metadata_addition: Canonical hashes added after completion using unchanged files; no rollout, actor or optimizer call
